ImageScanningTypes.description: The type of vulnerability scan that Image Builder runs for AMI output when ImageScanningEnabled is true. Specify a single value. If you omit ImageScanningTypes, Image Builder uses TEST_INSTANCE_CVE. With TEST_INSTANCE_CVE, Amazon Inspector scans the test instance during image tests, and you must activate Amazon Inspector for Amazon EC2 scanning in your account. With ON_DEMAND_AMI_CVE, Amazon Inspector starts an on-demand scan of the output AMI during image tests. You must build from an image recipe, but you do not need to activate Amazon Inspector in your account.

ImageScanningTypes.markdownDescription:
The type of vulnerability scan that Image Builder runs for AMI output when ImageScanningEnabled is true. Specify a single value. If you omit ImageScanningTypes, Image Builder uses TEST_INSTANCE_CVE. With TEST_INSTANCE_CVE, Amazon Inspector scans the test instance during image tests, and you must activate Amazon Inspector for Amazon EC2 scanning in your account. With ON_DEMAND_AMI_CVE, Amazon Inspector starts an on-demand scan of the output AMI during image tests. You must build from an image recipe, but you do not need to activate Amazon Inspector in your account.
